title: QUIC RFC 9000 Connection ID Retry Sequencing and Migration Pool Tail Work Item
summary: Close the remaining S5P1P1 tail by proving that client-selected and Retry-provided CIDs do not consume peer CID sequence numbers and that migrated-path use of a previously unused locally issued CID replenishes the peer-usable pool when allowed.
planned_changes:
- Route peer CID sequence seeding through the observed peer Initial Source CID when present.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for first client-selected CID reuse under explicit sequencing, Retry Source CID preferred-address sequencing, and invalid observed Initial Source CID reuse.
- Add migrated-path local CID replenishment tests covering allowed replenishment, peer active-limit suppression, and local issuance-budget suppression.
- Add focused architecture and verification artifacts and regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S5P1P1 tail requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused S5P1P1 tail proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0007 and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0019.
